description: The Aosta Valley region publishes, through its territorial information system and the Italian national geodata catalogue, two layers describing the fibre optic network built in the region under Italy's national ultra-broadband plan by the operator Open Fiber. The catalogue entries read on 2026-09-28 through the data.europa.eu interface describe a point layer of network elements such as manholes and street cabinets and a line layer of ducts, trenches and pole routes, both issued on 16 December 2024 and linked to the regional geoportal viewer. Coverage is the Aosta Valley region of Italy, covering the publicly funded network in areas the market did not serve. Access to the viewer is free; the catalogue entries give no licence and no download format, so reuse terms are unknown. Caveats: the layers show infrastructure built under the plan, not every operator's network, and whether bulk downloads exist beyond the viewer was not checked. It supports network and exposure studies of digital infrastructure, such as tracing fibre routes through valleys exposed to landslides or floods. Related record: the Austrian broadband atlas covers availability, not physical routes.
